'made test accuracy a direct financial matter for every patron'.
Loomis, Teague, Sill not named in Section A.

Ostrey Hollow skimming station, seven miles up, opened 4 May 1896. Borrowing from Larrow Green is not in A, but this is a core-fact item.
Weighing, composite sample and percent-on-neck mechanism not described.
Ammon & Sons, Tarnet; in use from 1 May 1897. The invoice date is absent from A, but this is a core-fact item.
